info.title: AP²I — Africa Public Project Intelligence
info.description:
Every Project. Every Dollar. Every Impact.

AP²I publishes information from official sources with provenance. Coverage is limited to connected sources. Alerts are signals for verification, not findings of wrongdoing.

get.description: One row per country. Countries without imported records get null statistics (never zeros).

CSV export of the project registry (one row per financing agreement). Registered users: 1,000 rows;
plans with the `exports` feature: unlimited.

put.description: Institution-specific thresholds (organization scope); super admins set AP²I defaults with org=None.
